questions.question:
f(x) = √(3x + 8)
The function f is defined by the given equation. If f(a) = −9a, where a is a constant, what is the value of a?
questions.explanation: Squaring √(3a + 8) = −9a gives 81a^2 − 3a − 8 = 0, so a = 1/3 or −8/27. Since the square root is nonnegative, −9a ≥ 0 and a = −8/27.

questions.question: In the figure shown, WZ and XY intersect at point Q, YQ = 36, WQ = 90, WX = 70, and XQ = 150. What is the length of YZ?
questions.explanation: The angles at W and Y are equal and the angles at Q are vertical angles, so triangle WQX is similar to triangle YQZ. YZ/WX = YQ/WQ = 36/90, so YZ = 70(0.4) = 28.

questions.question:
8(t + 4) − 10(t + 4) = 34
What value of t is the solution to the given equation?
questions.explanation: Combining like terms gives −2(t + 4) = 34, so t + 4 = −17 and t = −21.

questions.question: A researcher observes a sample of a nuclide. An exponential model estimates that the mass, in grams, of the sample decreases by 23% every 11.69 minutes. Which of the following equations could represent this model, where M is the estimated mass, in grams, of the sample t minutes after the researcher began observing the sample?
questions.explanation: A 23% decrease multiplies the mass by 0.77 once per 11.69 minutes, so M = 100(0.77)^(t/11.69).
